subject: science
concept: Understanding matter at the atomic level: atoms, elements, and the basic structure of the periodic table
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds simple atom models using physical bead/ball manipulatives for protons, neutrons, and electrons
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an element symbol to its position on a simplified periodic table
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the basic atomic structure of a given simple element

misconception_flags: confuses protons, neutrons, and electrons in terms of charge or location within the atom

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
